headline: American Bitcoin Secures $150 Million Loan Against Bitcoin Holdings
summary: Nasdaq-listed crypto miner American Bitcoin obtained a $150 million loan secured against its bitcoin holdings. The financing allows the company to borrow without selling its reserves or issuing new equity.
why: American Bitcoin is a Nasdaq-listed cryptocurrency mining firm that holds bitcoin as corporate treasury assets.

impacts.name: American Bitcoin
impacts.why: American Bitcoin secured a $150 million loan collateralized by its bitcoin reserves.
